title: Inside the AI Economy: What Stripe's Data Reveals — Nilofer Rajpurkar, Stripe
talk_summary: A Stripe product lead presents aggregate Stripe payment data on AI company growth, global selling, usage-based pricing, and agent-driven commerce. It is mostly market/GTM commentary with one concrete engineering pattern: shipping agent skills + MCP tools + sandbox provisioning so an agent can complete an end-to-end integration without credentials or human handoffs.

takeaways.technique: Agent skills + MCP server for a domain API
takeaways.what_they_do: Stripe ships an MCP server plus 'agent skills' (encoded best-practice guidance) so a coding agent picks the right integration pattern, asks clarifying questions, and builds end-to-end inside the agent session.
An agent CLI command creates an isolated sandbox and fetches scoped API keys automatically, so the agent reaches a working end-to-end demo without the human supplying credentials.
takeaways.evidence_quote: an agent is able to create a Stripe sandbox without me needing to provide any Stripe credentials up front. It goes ahead and grabs API keys for the sandbox

takeaways.what_they_do: They call out explicit agent guardrails for sensitive actions like money movement rather than trusting the agent's judgment.
takeaways.evidence_quote: agent guard rails for sensitive uh actions like money movement

takeaways.technique: Encode domain rules as reusable agent skills
takeaways.evidence_quote: It knows to recommend Stripe Checkout over card elements because Checkout has a better subscriptions integration
